subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Affect Heuristic: Feeling Is Believing
description: A 60-second lesson on Affect Heuristic: Feeling Is Believing.

hook.text: People told nuclear power is 'clean' rate its risks lower. Same technology, different framing, different fear.

buildup.text: Slovic found that our emotional reaction to a topic shapes our beliefs about its risks and benefits.

discovery.text: Affect heuristic: we use current feelings as data. If it feels good, it seems safe. If scary, it seems dangerous.

twist.text: Good mood makes you rate unrelated investments as safer. Your emotional weather colors all judgments.

climax.text: Feelings arrive before analysis. By the time you think, emotion has already voted on the answer.

punchline.text: You feel the answer before you think it.

quiz.question: What does the affect heuristic use as data?
